events.title: The Coin-Operated Shrine
events.body: A stone saint holds out one cupped hand, palm up. The gesture is unambiguous. Miracles, a small sign explains, are self-service.

events.title: The Spring
events.body: The water is clear, cold, and smug about it. It has healed a thousand adventurers before you and will absolutely bring that up.

events.title: A Merchant, Somehow
events.body: He has set up a full stall in a lightless ruin, hours from the nearest road. Do not ask about the overhead. He will tell you.

events.title: The Challenge Totem
events.body: The totem asks one question, carved deep: ARE YOU STRONG. The things waiting behind it would like to check your answer.

events.title: The Omen
events.body: A hooded figure shuffles cards that refuse to be counted. It offers the classic arrangement: glory if nobody falls. Otherwise, the other thing.

events.title: A Quiet Corner
events.body: Somebody swept this room, straightened the stones, and left. Whoever they were, they understood what adventurers truly need: five minutes.

events.title: The Reliquary
events.body: A royal reliquary, remarkably far from any royalty. The crown's lost property office has clearly given up. Finders, as the saying goes, keepers.

events.title: The Armory Ghost
events.body: The ghost of a quartermaster polishes gear that nobody requisitioned. Death has not improved his patience. His stock, however, remains impeccable.

events.title: The Miner's Cache
events.body: A tin lunchbox, a bent pickaxe, and a cache packed by someone who meant to come back for it. The mine disagrees with unattended property.

events.title: The Elder Root
events.body: The oldest tree in the wood has opinions, and rings to prove them. Tuition is payable in gold. Wisdom is dispensed by weight.

events.title: The Duckling Peddler
events.body: A cloaked figure opens one side of its coat. Inside sits a single duckling, radiating malice. 'Finest quality,' the peddler whispers. 'One per customer.'

events.title: The Surveyor
events.body: A dusty clerk sits behind a folding desk, surrounded by charts of everywhere but here. 'Twenty gold,' they say, not looking up. 'I already walked this floor. Twice. My knees are done subsidizing your curiosity.'

events.title: The Molting Stone
events.body: A cracked stone radiates a heat that gets under your skin - and keeps going. Scales prickle along your arms. For one battle you could be what the King fears most. The scoreboard, of course, has opinions about shortcuts.

events.title: The Pond Spirit
events.body: Something ancient surfaces in a puddle far too small for it. It offers renown - one hundred points of it, no less - and asks only that one of you, chosen by the pond, waddles the rest of the way. It will not say which of you. Ponds love surprises.

events.title: The Hungry Forge
events.body: A forge burns here with nothing left to make. It offers a trade older than smithing: feed it one piece of unworn gear from your bag, and your next battle will teach you twice as much. The forge is not sentimental. Choose something you are.

events.title: The Level Altar
events.body: A plain stone altar with a plaque: STAND HERE, BECOME MORE. The fine print, in much smaller letters, mentions that wisdom is exhausting and the management accepts no liability for empty reserves of magic.

events.title: A Familiar Hood
events.body: Someone in a very ordinary hood is sitting on a rock that was not there a moment ago. They have a story, apparently. Stories restore the spirit - twenty points of it, to be exact, for whichever of you listens hardest.

events.title: The Token Changer
events.body: A folding table, a set of scales, and a clerk who does not blink. The sign lists exactly one exchange rate: ONE legendary token buys THREE rest tokens, or ONE piece of somebody else's map. No refunds. The scales are for show.

events.title: The Cold Trail
events.body: A shallow basin of ash and herbs, left by someone who knew how patrols think. Scatter it over your tracks and every patrol in the place starts its count again from a comfortable one hundred.

events.title: The Reels
events.body: A gaudy machine, deep underground, plugged into nothing. Its reels show tax papers, a goose head, a spoon shaped like a P, a crown, a red X, a bald head with a red beard, and a 7. One spin costs ten gold. Three cost seventy. The machine considers this a bargain and will not be discussing it.

events.title: The Dealer
events.body: A folding card table, one candle, and a dealer whose face you will not remember afterward. The rules are old and fair-ish: bet gold, draw to twenty-one, the dealer stands on seventeen. Win, and the bet comes back doubled. Lose, and the candle burns a little brighter.

events.title: The Flock
events.body: The reeds part. A hundred pairs of small black eyes consider your party and reach, collectively, a decision: you would all make excellent geese. Just for one fight. The scoreboard, unusually, agrees - three hundred points say so.
